model.summary: Model favors HOU by 5.4 points (70% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (HOU +2.2), Defense EPA allowed/play (season blend) (HOU +0.7), Scoring margin (season blend) (HOU +0.6). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 47.2 total points (HOU 26, NYG 21). Biggest factors: Natural grass field (raises total 0.7), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 0.6), Combined rushing offense EPA/play (lowers total 0.5). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
